pronunciationProposals.Rook: rook, as in the chess piece
pronunciationProposals.Chog: chog, short o (brand pronunciation confirmation pending)

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Two centuries ago, the world survived the creatures that nearly destroyed it. Their name was Chog. Their memory was the last danger we erased.
lines.direction: Authoritarian but natural, like an archivist reading an uncontested public record. Mid-low register, measured breath, no movie-trailer growl. Small pause after the first sentence, isolate Chog, then let erased land coldly. Do not sound triumphant or imitate a real public figure.
lines.markedText: Two centuries ago, the world survived the creatures that nearly destroyed it.<break time="350ms"/> Their name was <emphasis level="moderate">Chog</emphasis>.<break time="450ms"/> Their memory was the last danger we <emphasis level="moderate">erased</emphasis>.

lines.speaker: neri
lines.text: If they're all gone, why are we still hunting them?
lines.direction: A 19-year-old adult, grounded and alert. Quiet question to herself, not a speech. Begin almost obediently; on still hunting let genuine doubt break through. Avoid a childlike anime squeak, melodrama or a shout.
lines.markedText: If they're all gone,<break time="230ms"/> why are we <emphasis level="moderate">still hunting</emphasis> them?

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Excuse me? I'm a legendary being of unimaginable power.
lines.direction: Small mischievous spirit, nimble and self-important rather than shrill. Offended interruption on Excuse me, a comic half-beat, then absurdly sincere pride. Smile through legendary. Use an original consenting voice, not a recognizable cartoon impersonation.
lines.markedText: Excuse me?<break time="300ms"/> I'm a <emphasis level="moderate">legendary</emphasis> being of unimaginable power.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: I remember the sea. And a door. Why can't I remember the rest?
lines.direction: Same voice as the boast, but the smile slips. Sea is a real sensory memory; door is discovered in the act of speaking. Final question is frightened and intimate, not a joke. Preserve natural breath rather than digital pitch manipulation.
lines.markedText: I remember the sea.<break time="350ms"/> And a door.<break time="500ms"/> Why can't I remember the rest?

lines.speaker: sera
lines.text: Place the drawing on the floor. Your life depends on what you do next.
lines.direction: Controlled captain, adult and precise, mid-low register. The command is quiet because she expects obedience. Pause, then sincere danger beneath the authority; no shouting, hissing or villain caricature. Keep this voice identical to line 08.
lines.markedText: Place the drawing on the floor.<break time="350ms"/> Your life depends on what you do <emphasis level="moderate">next</emphasis>.

lines.speaker: chog-witness
lines.text: We ran toward the sea, not away from it. We were trying to close the door.
lines.direction: A distinct mature witness, weary and lucid; plain testimony, no supernatural growl. Stress toward only enough to overturn the official history. Closing the door was an urgent act of protection. Any memory-space reverb belongs in a later mix, never printed into the dry source.
lines.markedText: We ran <emphasis level="moderate">toward</emphasis> the sea, not away from it.<break time="400ms"/> We were trying to close the door.

lines.speaker: rook
lines.text: He's the reason I was sent to find you.
lines.direction: Warm, quick harbor smuggler; a little air and a disarming half-smile. Begin conversationally, then drop the salesmanship for sent to find you. Do not assign a stereotyped accent or imitate a named actor.
lines.markedText: He's the reason I was <emphasis level="moderate">sent</emphasis> to find you.

lines.speaker: sera
lines.direction: Same captain as line 05. No is controlled, a real pause, then a small private fracture on mother. Do not over-telegraph a reveal with sobbing. The weight comes from the contrast with her earlier precision.
lines.markedText: No.<break time="650ms"/> But my mother did.
